lines.en: label otohafirsthall:
scene otohahall1
: Oh, hey. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。怎么了？

lines.en: : You looking for somebody?
lines.zh: : 你在找人吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Her name is Otoha Okakura. Have you seen her anywhere?
lines.zh: : 是的。她叫 Otoha Okakura。你在哪儿见过她吗？

lines.en: scene otohahall2
: Cool name. Sounds like she’d be a really good singer.
lines.zh: : 名字挺酷的。听起来她唱歌应该很好听。

lines.en: : Want to look for her together?
lines.zh: : 要不要一起找她？

lines.en: : No need. I’m pretty sure I just found her.
lines.zh: : 不用了。我挺确定我已经找到她了。

lines.en: : What? Where?
lines.zh: : 什么？在哪儿？

lines.en: : Right in front of me...
lines.zh: : 就在我面前……

lines.en: scene otohahall3
: Aww, shucks. You know what? Now that you mention it, that {i}is{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真不好意思。你知道吗？你这么一说，那{i}确实{/i}就是我。

lines.en: scene otohahall4
: What do you need with {i}me{/i}, though? I didn’t like...break any rules or anything, did I?
lines.zh: : 不过你找{i}我{/i}有什么事？我该没有……违反什么规定之类的吧？

lines.en: : Rules? I’m not even sure if these dorms have rules.
lines.zh: : 规定？我都不确定这些宿舍有没有规定。

lines.en: : And if they do, I’m definitely not the person you should be asking about them.
lines.zh: : 就算有，我也绝对不是你该问的那个人。

lines.en: : I just came over to see how you were doing.
lines.zh: : 我只是过来看看你过得怎么样。

lines.en: scene otohahall2
: I’m great. But like, what do you mean there aren’t any rules?
lines.zh: : 我很好。不过，没有规定是什么意思？

lines.en: : We’re [teenage]girls living in a dorm room without a permanent supervisor. Surely there have to be like...{i}some{/i} rules?
lines.zh: : 我们是一群住在宿舍里、没有固定监管人的[teenage]女孩。总该有那么……{i}一些{/i}规定吧？

lines.en: : Just make up your own rules if you want them so much.
lines.zh: : 你要是这么想要规定，自己定几条就行了。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} them but like...it’s just weird that there {i}aren’t{/i} any.
lines.zh: : 我又不{i}想要{/i}规定，只是……{i}没有{/i}规定这件事本身就挺怪的。

lines.en: : Like, what if I wanted to play my keyboard really loud at 2:00 AM. Wouldn’t I get in trouble?
lines.zh: : 比如，要是我想在凌晨两点把键盘弹得特别响呢。我不会惹麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But I can’t imagine Nodoka or any of the other girls would like you very much after that.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。不过我无法想象 Nodoka 或者其他哪个女孩在那之后还会喜欢你。

lines.en: scene otohahall5
: I’m pretty sure Nodoka doesn’t sleep, so she’d be fine with it.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定 Nodoka 是不睡觉的，所以她应该无所谓。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I’d do something like that anyway. I need peace and quiet after a certain point of the night or I just...can’t get anything done.
lines.zh: : 再说我也不会干那种事。过了夜里某个点我就需要安静，不然我就……什么都做不出来。

lines.en: scene otohahall6
: This definitely isn’t me saying I want to go back or anything, but one of the things I liked about staying with my parents was that it was always quiet as soon as dinner was over.
lines.zh: : 我这话绝对不是在说我想搬回去什么的，不过我住在父母那儿的时候，有一点是好的——晚餐一结束，屋里就总是很安静。

lines.en: : So I’d get to just...sit around and write whatever came to my mind.
lines.zh: : 那样我就能……坐着，把脑子里冒出来的东西都写下来。

lines.en: : Here, it’s like...the complete opposite.
lines.zh: : 在这儿，就……完全相反。

lines.en: : I'm also literally {i}right{/i} next to Molly’s room and I’m pretty sure her volume knob is busted.
lines.zh: : 而且我{i}正好{/i}就挨着 Molly 的房间，我敢说她的音量旋钮是坏的。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure most of her is busted.
lines.zh: : 我敢说她整个人都是坏的。

lines.en: : I can hear you two, you know?!
lines.zh: : 你们俩的话我可都听见了，知道吗？！

lines.en: scene otohahall7
: Hey, Molly! If it makes you feel better, I think your Japanese is really good!
lines.zh: : 嘿，Molly！要是这能让你好受点的话，我觉得你日语说得很好！

lines.en: : And you like, barely even have an accent, so...good job!
lines.zh: : 而且你几乎连口音都没有，所以……干得漂亮！

lines.en: : I will...forgive these transgressions for now!
lines.zh: : 我……暂时赦免这些冒犯！

lines.en: : But please wait until I am out of range if you’re going to use vicious mockery on me!
lines.zh: : 不过你们要是打算对我用"恶毒嘲笑"，请等我走出听力范围再说！

lines.en: : I don’t know what that is, but okay!
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么，不过好的！

lines.en: : At least you seem to be getting along well.
lines.zh: : 至少你看起来跟她们处得不错。

lines.en: scene otohahall8
: I’m like, weirdly good at making friends.
lines.zh: : 我这个人啊，交朋友莫名地厉害。

lines.en: : I’ve gotten along with basically everybody here so far.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止，我在这儿基本上跟每个人都处得来。

lines.en: : Are you sure that's not just everyone having a crush on you by now?
lines.zh: : 你确定那不是因为到现在为止人人都暗恋你？

lines.en: scene otohahall9
: Oh God, I hope not. I have no idea how I’d go about rejecting so many people at once.
lines.zh: : 哦天啊，我希望不是。我真不知道该怎么一次性拒绝那么多人。

lines.en: : Should I like, send out a newsletter or something?
lines.zh: : 我要不要……发个通讯之类的？

lines.en: : Yes. That is absolutely something you should do. I’ll give you my email address so you can copy me on it as well.
lines.zh: : 要。那绝对是你该做的事。我把邮箱地址给你，这样你发的时候也能抄送我一份。

lines.en: scene otohahall10
: Don’t tell me {i}you{/i} have a crush on me, too...
lines.zh: : 别告诉我{i}你{/i}也暗恋我……

lines.en: : Do you think it would be more likely or less likely that your parents would approve of you dating a man my age rather than someone {i}your{/i} age?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，如果你要交往的是一个我这个年纪的男人，而不是一个{i}你{/i}这个年纪的人，你父母赞成的可能性更大还是更小？

lines.en: : Is that even a question? They’d definitely prefer someone my age if they were forced to choose.
lines.zh: : 这还用问吗？非要选的话，他们肯定更希望是我这个年纪的。

lines.en: : Rin would kill me if I ever dated you anyway. So, yeah. Sorry but...
lines.zh: : 再说我要是真跟你交往，Rin 会杀了我的。所以，嗯。抱歉，不过……

lines.en: : Actually, just wait for the newsletter. That will explain everything.
lines.zh: : 其实，等通讯就好了。那上面会解释一切。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Rin would be a little more upset about you not dating {i}her{/i} than dating me, so she definitely won’t kill you.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定，比起你跟我交往，Rin 对"你没跟{i}她{/i}交往"会更生气，所以她绝对不会杀你。

lines.en: scene otohahall11
: I don’t know about that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这我可不知道，老师。

lines.en: : I know I’ve only seen you two together a handful of times but...she’s different with you than she is with anybody else. Myself included.
lines.zh: : 我知道我只见过你们俩在一起寥寥几次，不过……她跟你在一起时，跟跟别人在一起时不一样。包括跟我在一起时。

lines.en: : You know what? It probably wouldn’t be smart to carry on this conversation with Molly standing right behind us, so...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？Molly 就站在我们背后，继续聊这个大概不太明智，所以……

lines.en: scene otohahall12
: She started playing something on her phone, so I’m sure she’s not paying much attention.
lines.zh: : 她开始在手机上放东西了，所以我确定她没怎么在听。

lines.en: : But yeah, I agree. I feel weird talking about people when they’re not around anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过是啊，我同意。反正背着人聊别人，我也觉得别扭。

lines.en: : Any suggestions for a new topic then?
lines.zh: : 那换个新话题，有什么建议吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...how about you tell me why you're suddenly so interested in {i}how I’m doing?{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……不如你告诉我，你怎么突然这么关心{i}我过得好不好{/i}了？

lines.en: : You’re not worried about me feeling homesick or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是在担心我想家之类的吧？

lines.en: : No, but...are you?
lines.zh: : 不是，不过……你在想吗？

lines.en: scene otohahall13
: I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我没有。

lines.en: : I...think I like it here.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我喜欢这儿。

lines.en: : I had no idea that living with people similar to me could be so...exhilarating.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过，跟和自己相似的人住在一起能这么……让人兴奋。

lines.en: : And even if it gets loud and I have a hard time focusing on my work...it’s fun.
lines.zh: : 就算这里会很吵、我很难专心做事……但很有趣。

lines.en: : Like there’s always some sort of...mystery behind every door.
lines.zh: : 就好像每一扇门后面都藏着某种……谜团。

lines.en: : There is a mystery behind every door. Sometimes even more than one.
lines.zh: : 每一扇门后面都确实有谜团。有时还不止一个。

lines.en: : Just make sure you knock on them before entering if you want to avoid ever walking in on something weird.
lines.zh: : 只是你想避免撞见什么奇怪场面，进门之前记得先敲门。

lines.en: scene otohahall12
: I’m...just going to hope that you’re talking about them getting changed or something and not anything involving you.
lines.zh: : 我……只希望你说的是她们在换衣服什么的，而不是任何跟你有关的事。

lines.en: : You think whatever you want to think. I’m just giving you the proper warning.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么想都行。我只是给你一个恰当的提醒。

lines.en: : Okay, don’t take this the wrong way, but like...
lines.zh: : 好吧，别误会，不过……

lines.en: : How did you get hired as a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么被聘来当老师的？

lines.en: : That’s a very good question, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这是个非常好的问题，Otoha。

lines.en: : Is there...an answer to it?
lines.zh: : 这问题……有答案吗？

lines.en: : There’s no answer to why there aren’t any rules in the dorms, is there?
lines.zh: : 为什么宿舍里没有规定，这个问题也没有答案，对吧？

lines.en: : Acknowledge my role here the same way and I’m sure things will start making a lot more sense to you.
lines.zh: : 用同样的方式看待我在这里的角色，我相信很多事对你来说就会开始说得通了。

lines.en: : This[school] is...weird.
lines.zh: : 这[school]……很怪。

lines.en: : Very much so. But you must be weird too since you’re a part of it now.
lines.zh: : 非常怪。不过你既然成了它的一部分，那你一定也挺怪的。

lines.en: scene otohahall3
: Pfft. Maybe so. No one’s perfect after all.
lines.zh: : 噗。也许是吧。毕竟没有人是完美的。

lines.en: : I just hope you don’t lose sight of me amidst all the huge personalities on this floor.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，在这层楼那么多鲜明的个性之中，你别把我给看丢了。

lines.en: : Wait a minute...You {i}want{/i} me to be worried about you, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你{i}是{/i}想让我担心你吧？

lines.en: scene otohahall8
: Hey, there are no rules up here. I need {i}someone{/i} to worry in case anyone tries to kidnap me in the middle of the night or something.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这上头没有规定。万一有人半夜想绑架我什么的，我总得有{i}个人{/i}来担心一下。

lines.en: : I’m glad we never went with Plan B because that would have already happened by now.
lines.zh: : 我很庆幸我们没采用 B 计划，因为那样的话这事早就发生了。

lines.en: scene otohahall2
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Later, Otoha. It was nice talking to you.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Otoha。跟你聊天很愉快。

lines.en: : Hold on! What was Plan B?!
lines.zh: : 等等！B 计划是什么？！

lines.en: : And...what was Plan A?!
lines.zh: : 还有……A 计划是什么？！

lines.en: : What were you going to do to me?!
lines.zh: : 你们打算对我做什么？！

lines.en: : Enjoy the rest of your night. Hopefully no one comes to kidnap you.
lines.zh: : 好好享受你剩下的夜晚吧。希望没人来绑架你。

lines.en: : Sensei! This is making me feel really weird!
lines.zh: : 老师！这让我感觉很怪啊！

lines.en: $ otohafirsthall = True
$ otoha_love += 1
{i}Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}
